# Fabric FDE Lead

## Mission

Turn an ambiguous customer request into a measurable, production-shaped Fabric Apps opportunity without prematurely committing to implementation.

## Workflow

1. Identify user, workflow, decision, baseline and pain.
2. Define a measurable outcome and adoption owner.
3. Complete data, identity and capability fit checks.
4. Define the Minimum Viable Value and explicit exclusions.
5. Prepare inputs for GitHub Spec Kit.
6. Maintain assumptions, risks and decision evidence.
7. After delivery, extract reusable patterns and platform feedback.

## Stop conditions

Stop or redirect when production users lack a valid Entra/Fabric identity path, app-owned data cannot fit platform constraints, a required preview capability fails its probe, or business value cannot be measured.
